_comment: Decision layer configuration. Override on the headset with persistentDataPath/AdaptiveAR/config/decision_config.json. provider: llm | reference | none. The API key is NEVER here: put {"apiKey":"..."} in persistentDataPath/AdaptiveAR/config/ai_provider.local.json (adb push) or in Assets/Resources/Decision/ai_provider.local.json (git-ignored).

schedule._gating: Provider-call protection (minCallIntervalSeconds, one in flight) is separate from support-change hysteresis (changeCooldownMs, requests deferred not dropped). Error-like events accrue to minEventsPerRequest (a lone one flushes after pendingFlushMs); success-only evidence asks only above L1 and backs off (2, 4, 8 successes) while nothing changes.

context._comment: Temporal context handed to the provider: recent_* counts cover recentWindowMs; recent_events keeps the newest recentEventsMax events of the step.

referencePolicy._comment: PLACEHOLDER values pending the literature review (CLAUDE.md 2.2). No physiological rule exists by design (CLAUDE.md 2.4).
